thread:
Olivia (CS): FYI — Acme Logistics says they wired EUR 22,500 yesterday for invoice INV-2026-102 but didn't include the invoice number or PO. Our EUR clearing acct shows the incoming credit but no remittance text. Can someone help reconcile?
Emma (Finance): Can you drop the exact timestamp + amount from the customer's payment confirmation? We can try match by amount/date but need at least one unique identifier.
Olivia (CS): Customer provided this payment confirmation PDF, but their AP team shows only beneficiary name + IBAN. No PO field. Timestamp on their remittance: 2026-03-02 14:12 CET, value date 2026-03-03. Amount EUR 22,500.
Javier (SupportOps): Upload the PDF here and redact bank acct numbers if needed. Also pinged payments-bot to see if the incoming wire has an MT103 record in our bank feed.
payments-bot: Incoming wire noticed into EUR-clearing-1 — amount: 22500.00 EUR — value_date: 2026-03-03 — ordering_institution: ACME LOGISTICS — remittance_info: "" — bank_ref: 0045XYZ (internal).
Liam (Accounting): If remittance_info is empty we need either a SWIFT MT103 copy from the payer bank or a bank trace to surface the beneficiary reference. Without that, allocation will stay unapplied. I can attempt a best-match by aging + amount but prefer confirmation.
Olivia (CS): I've asked Acme AP for an MT103 / SWIFT copy and their PO number. They replied AP system doesn't push PO into the payment description. They can request the sending bank to include "INV-2026-102" in the reference and re-send a confirmation, but that can take 48-72h.
Emma (Finance): Short-term workaround: do we have any other open invoices to Acme with exactly EUR 22,500? Check outstanding list. If it's unique, we can create a pending allocation with a note and clear once MT103 arrives. Need approval for risk.
Liam (Accounting): Checked AR ledger: INV-2026-102 is for EUR 22,500 and is still open. There are no other AR items for Acme with that exact amount. I'll prepare a manual allocation entry and flag for review: reason="match by amount + payment confirmation from customer". We should still get MT103 for audit.
Olivia (CS): Customer just uploaded a screenshot of their bank transfer instruction showing "Beneficiary reference: ACMEPO9876" — but that string is NOT present in our bank feed remittance. Could be omitted by intermediary bank.
Javier (SupportOps): Re-request MT103 specifically and ask customer to supply the full SWIFT copy (MT103/MT202 trace). Also ask them to include the originating bank transaction id (if available). I'll open a bank trace with our treasury partner — need ordering bank name and value date.
payments-bot: Trace request created: TRACE-2026-03-03-71. Bank partner will attempt to retrieve the sending bank's message (3–5 business days).
Emma (Finance): Noted possible VAT handling: invoice INV-2026-102 has 20% VAT included. If the payer did an international wire, there may be withholding or FX differences. When you allocate, please record any FX gain/loss and VAT treatment.
Liam (Accounting): Will do. Created manual allocation record AO-1769, status=pending. Attached payment confirmation URL and note: "awaiting MT103 for audit, matched by amount & customer confirmation."
Olivia (CS): Update from Acme: their bank provided the MT103 PDF — it includes field 70: "INV INV-2026-102 ACMEPO9876". They also included sending bank trace id 55TRX-8891. Forwarding the MT103 now.
Javier (SupportOps): Received MT103. Confirmed field 70 contains invoice number + PO. Reconcile: bank_ref 0045XYZ vs MT103 ordering id 55TRX-8891 — intermediaries likely stripped remittance in our feed. I'll attach MT103 to the bank transaction for the audit trail.
Liam (Accounting): Applied payment to INV-2026-102. Cleared bank transaction and closed AO-1769. Noted FX variance of -12.34 EUR booked to FX loss. VAT intact.
Emma (Finance): Marking as reconciled in AR and moving to closed. Please update internal KB with: "If remittance_info empty but MT103 contains invoice/PO, attach MT103 and proceed with manual allocation; label record with trace id."
Olivia (CS): Will update the KB and remind major customers to include invoice number in the beneficiary reference. Also asked product to add a new field in billing portal to encourage PO inclusion on instructing payments.
Javier (SupportOps): Closing loop — payments-bot: please attach MT103 PDF to the transaction and record TRACE-2026-03-03-71 in the case.
payments-bot: MT103 attached to txn 0045XYZ, trace id recorded. Case closed. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Single continuous string of the Slack thread; messages are chronological and prefixed with sender names. No title field as required.
